seo.title: Cura — Evidence Package Builder
seo.description: When a passenger escalates to the authority or to court, Cura's Evidence Package Builder pulls every source over an API — weather, NOTAMs, slot messages, delay codes and booking data — drafts the response and files it. All the airline does is approve it for sending.

facts.title: Every source, pulled in parallel
facts.body: Weather, NOTAMs, slot messages, delay codes, booking data — every source fetched over an API the moment the request lands. Gaps are flagged, never left out quietly.

facts.title: Approve it. That's the whole job.
facts.body: The agent categorises the cause, attributes the delay, answers every item in the authority's structure and recommends defend or settle. Nobody collects, chases or writes anything. The handler reads it and presses send.

facts.title: Every ruling makes the next one better
facts.body: Every ruling is stored with its reasoning and fed back into the drafting agent. Next quarter's package is built on what the authority actually decided this one.

nodes.title: Read and matched
list: Claim found — matched to the case on file
No claim — new case is opened

reference.title: Legal response engine — data & flow list
reference.body: The complete step-by-step data and flow list behind the engine above: every trigger, source, computation and human checkpoint, end to end.

steps.title: Request arrives → workflow trigger
items: Inbound email to a monitored address (NEB, airline legal, court)
Full message + attachments stored raw before any processing
Trigger fires one journey run per message

steps.title: Read and understand the request
items: Extract: booking reference, passenger names, flight number and date, claim type, what the authority is asking for
Read attachments too (passenger's complaint, authority's form, prior correspondence)
Confidence score per extracted field — anything below threshold goes to a human before a record is touched

steps.title: Match to a claim in Cura
items: Exists → load everything: claim record, airline's original decision and decision letter, evidence sealed at decision time, correspondence history
Doesn't exist → create the claim from the extracted PNR and flight, flagged escalation-first (evidence will have to be assembled retroactively)
Match confirmed by a person if the PNR or passenger name is uncertain

steps.title: Classify the request and start the clock
items: Requester type: NEB (AESA, LBA, DGAC…) vs. airline's own lawyer vs. court
Authority file reference → idempotency key (reminders and duplicates don't create a second case)
Deadline rule from a jurisdiction table in Cura (AESA = 20 working days), reminders at 25/50/75%
Exactly what was asked for — itemised, kept verbatim in the case

steps.title: Flight & rotation facts
items: STD/ATD/STA/ATA, gate and runway times, actual routing, holds, diversions, alternate used
Inbound aircraft rotation (previous 2 legs, same tail) — for chain-of-delay defences
Aircraft registration, type, operating carrier

steps.title: Weather
items: Observations for departure, arrival and alternate, window = ETD −3h to ATA +1h
Published approach minima for the runway in use (AIP / Jeppesen)
Computed: did conditions sit below minima, and for how long

items.text: NOTAMs for all airports involved — reliable only from the airline's crew briefing pack months later
ATFM regulation / flow restriction, CTOT and slot messages

steps.title: Airline operational data
items: PNR, ticket numbers, passengers, fare class, booking date and channel
Check-in and boarding acceptance record, door-opening time
IATA delay codes (primary + sub), OCC/duty manager notes, crew duty limits if relevant
Maintenance record if technical cause claimed (AOG log, defect, MEL reference)

steps.title: Passenger-side evidence
items: Every notification sent: channel, timestamp, content, delivery receipt
Rebooking offered vs. accepted, alternative transport including ground
Duty of care provided: meals, vouchers, hotel, transfer
Claim history: what was filed, what was decided, decision letter, correspondence

steps.title: Compute the facts — deterministic, versioned code, never AI
items: Arrival delay at destination in minutes, great-circle distance, EU261 compensation band
Notice period for cancellations (14-day rule), rerouting thresholds
Output = signed facts object, with source + timestamp + checksum per field

steps.title: Gap check → tell the agent what's missing
items: Each requested item marked have / partial / missing
Missing items surface in the Cura agent view as a short task list: who supplies it, by when
Deadline recalculated against the gap; case flagged red if a mandatory item is unobtainable

steps.title: Fight-or-pay recommendation
items: Inputs: facts object, cause category, evidence completeness score, claim value, historical outcomes for this cause + this authority
Hard rules override the AI both ways — technical fault with no extraordinary-circumstance basis → pay; evidence below threshold → pay or request extension
Output: recommendation, confidence, the 3 facts driving it, estimated exposure (compensation + care + authority cost)

steps.title: Assemble the response
steps.tag: AI drafts prose only, from computed facts
items: Cover letter in the authority's language, matching their itemised request
Statement of facts, legal position with case law references, annex index
Annexes as PDFs with a per-document provenance page

steps.title: Agent review in Cura
items: Read the compiled file, edit any field or paragraph, override the recommendation with a mandatory reason
Every edit stored as a diff against the AI draft — this is training data
Approve → locked version, named approver, timestamp

steps.title: Send and record
items: Submission to the authority's portal or by email, receipt stored
Status → Filed, pack version archived immutable

steps.title: Follow-ups before judgment
items: Passenger's hearing response (10 working days in Spain) → new inbound event, re-enters step 2
Authority's additional questions → same path, incremental pack version

steps.title: Judgment received
items: Outcome: upheld / partially upheld / rejected, amount ordered, reasoning text
Which of our arguments were accepted and which dismissed — extracted as tagged reasons
Compliance branch: pay via Cura settlement, or appeal → new case linked to the parent

steps.title: The learning store
items: One outcome record per case: cause category, authority, country, evidence items present, our recommendation, the agent's decision, actual outcome, argument-level accept/reject
Feeds three things: the scoring model in step 12, the evidence checklist in step 11, the draft templates in step 13
Aggregate view per authority: win rate by cause, time to decision, arguments that NEB never accepts
Recalibration is a scheduled batch job with a versioned model — never silent, always reviewable
